data.description:
## Description

**What**: New plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/strata-sdk-guidance/ with three files: brainstorm.md (~30 lines: when-to-use SDK vs plain Rails; common epic shapes; capability-verification heuristics); preplanning.md (~30 lines: story-decomposition heuristics for SDK chains; E2E nudge for Strata-scoped epics; multi-concept reconciliation checklist); implementation-plan.md (~30 lines: pitfall WHYs — ActionController::API hook mechanics, Case-Form FK rationale, generator chain semantics, underscored-flag silent-ignore; SDK test helper exemplars (~15 line signature table) citing lockpick as implementation source, marked exemplars not canonical).
**Why**: Manual guidance complements auto-regenerated facts with SDK-rationale and per-skill heuristics.
**Scope**:
- IN: Three manual-guidance files; signature-only test helper table; lockpick attribution; clear "exemplars not canonical" framing.
- OUT: Auto-regenerated facts (separate story); per-skill conditional loading (separate stories).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, three guidance files exist with content per scope ← Satisfies: epic In Scope
- When complete, file lengths approximately match the targets (30/30/30) — token budget honored ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, test helper table is signature-only, not implementation copy ← Satisfies: epic In Scope
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for structural validation (file lengths, mandatory headings)

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Manual guidance staleness advisory triggers on decomposition.md hash change

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a planning skill consumer, per-skill manual guidance files exist for brainstorm/preplanning/implementation-plan
